variants.headline: Cyclone hits the colony
variants.sub: The colony has been struck by a cyclone.
variants.body:
A cyclone has hit {colony}. The storm is established, but a particular loss or injury is not. Readers considering {target} should distinguish scrutiny of responsibility from blame for causing a natural event, and should not be asked to accept an invented damage total as part of the report.

The gazette records the cyclone while withholding particulars of consequences not supplied to this notice. A natural event and the administrative response to it are distinct subjects. The public record should not attribute specific damage, casualties or measures to the storm on the strength of its occurrence alone.

The conduct of {target} should be examined without treating the cyclone as proof of a particular response. This account records a natural event and avoids an unreported judgment of its physical consequences. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.
